subject: Cloudful onboarding timeline — quick pulse and next steps
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lin <jared.lin@cloudful.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Cloudful onboarding timeline — post-call recap + vendor packet

Hi Jared — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned:

Call highlights
- Primary use case: real-time inference for dashboard summaries (internal BI)
- Initial scope: 3 models, ~60M tokens/month, target 99th p95 latency < 250ms
- Info security: they need vendor evidence (SOC2) and standard PO/ACH setup

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
1) I’ll send our vendor packet + sample SOW (attached) — Ava — sent now.
2) Cloudful procurement to confirm portal invite and W-9/ACH preference — Jared — aim this week.
3) Technical kickoff (30–45m) with our infra lead once vendor access is provisioned — Connor — pending portal.

Attachments: Redwood-VendorPacket.pdf (vendor packet + SOW stub)

Can you confirm the right procurement email and whether ACH is preferable for Cloudful? If procurement needs anything else from our side (KYC, tax ID), I can get it over today.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

—
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

- They requested a completed W-9 from Redwood for vendor setup (I can route once you send it)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Cloudful onboarding timeline — post-call recap + vendor packet

Marissa / Connor — looping you in. Jared confirmed procurement is the bottleneck and specifically asked for a completed W-9. I attached the vendor packet above; we should send the W-9 + a short note to procurement to keep momentum.

Suggested ask to procurement: please confirm portal invite date, preferred payment method (ACH/wire), and whether PO or signed SOW is required to create the vendor record. If procurement will need a contract redline, ask for the contact and timeline.

Connor, can you prepare a 1-page tech checklist (what they need to provide for us to run private inference) that we can include in the portal notes? Marissa — can you advise if we should offer a short-term credit while they finish vendor onboarding if timing looks slow?

Thanks —
Ava
